articles.headline: Gio Ruggiero wins Hard Rock Bet 300 (Championship Race)
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Gio Ruggiero won Hard Rock Bet 300 (Championship Race) at Homestead-Miami Speedway, starting P10 and leading 70 laps. Parker Retzlaff finished second and Austin Hill was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 10 cautions.

Corey Day was the biggest mover, gaining 24 spots from P29 to P5.

Gio Ruggiero leads the championship with 1253 points, 197 ahead of Austin Hill.
